extra_io_pla_direct.description: PLA ROM input cell state: the AND term uses the input as is (glyph I).

extra_io_pla_input_cell.description: TalkBack name of a PLA ROM matrix input cell; the input index counts down like the column headers.

extra_io_pla_negated.description: PLA ROM input cell state: the AND term uses the inverted input (glyph ¬I).

extra_io_pla_output_cell.description: TalkBack name of a PLA ROM matrix output cell, a checkbox that connects the term to the output.

extra_io_pla_unused.description: PLA ROM input cell state: the AND term ignores the input (glyph ·).
